monitors.consumer: main docs/reports/STATE.md (its commits); a stale generated copy (> 3 h) is logged and not committed -- stallcheck's stategen freshness check is the alarm
monitors.note: scripts/mac/state-relay.sh, StartInterval 3600: scp ~/digest/STATE.md from the canary host, splice main's NOTES block, commit + push only when the generated block changed (or the committed copy is > 6 h old); fetch + rebase, never force.
